Diventate parte del nostro team ora e plasmate il futuro della cura! Gestione e organizzazione del dipartimento di nascita in un duo con un team impegnato e motivato di circa 25 ostetriche (comprese le ore di ufficio ambulatorio presso la sede SZB, così come le emergenze ginecologiche al di fuori delle ore di ufficio)

Ottimizzazione e co-creazione dello sviluppo specialistico nella Frauenklinik basata sull'uso mirato dei gruppi di lavoro

Co-responsabilità nel garantire il mandato di formazione degli studenti e stabilire gli obiettivi per i dipendenti nell'ulteriore istruzione

Promuovere la cooperazione costruttiva nel team e le aree di interfaccia della Frauen-enklinik / Kinderklinik e partner esterni

Team leader Birth Department / Midwife (80-100%) - Hospital Center Biel / Centre hospitalier Bienne Working on the pulse of life: With more than 2300 employees, Hospital Center Biel is one of the leading hospitals in the region, known for its innovative strength and proximity to patients. Become part of our team now and shape the future of care! You are an experienced and motivated midwife who is looking for the next step with a lot of responsibility and co-creation possibilities? Then we have the perfect place for you! As team leader, you are responsible for our birth department with around 900 births per year. Together with the second team leader, Myriam Schwab, experts and education managers, you will help us to drive improvements and ensure high quality. There are many great and varied tasks waiting for you, apply now and learn more! To strengthen the management circle, we are looking for a team leader birth department / midwife (80-100%) as of 01.09.2026 or by agreement: You are responsible for ensuring holistic care and support for pregnant women, childbearers and newborns as well as their caregivers.

Management and organisation of the birth department in a duo with a committed and motivated team of around 25 midwives (including outpatient office hours at the location SZB, as well as gynaecological emergencies outside office hours)

Project coordination and management in renewals/further developments in the women’s clinic

Optimization and co-creation of the specialist development in the Frauenklinik based on targeted use of working groups

Co-responsibility in securing the training mandate of students and setting the goals for employees in further education

Promoting constructive cooperation in the team as well as interface areas of the Frauen-enklinik / Kinderklinik and external partners

Diploma as midwife HF/FH with several years of practical experience in the birth department management experience of advantage Social competence and empathy for a professional and human encounter, even in complex situations High sense of responsibility with strong organizational ability, structured way of working and economic action Open and winning personality with a high patient orientation, which actively promotes appreciative communication and good cooperation with different professional groups mother tongue German or French and with good knowledge of the other language (min. B1)

Attractive working conditions: Flexible working hours and wishes are observed as far as possible and can be organized in the management circle. Support for progression in German or French, family-friendly personnel policy with day-care, easy accessibility with public transport and the car (parking facilities available) Career prospects: support for further education and individual development opportunities. Strong team: An appreciative corporate culture and a motivated team that pulls together. Introduction time: We attach great importance to the arrival and integration in the hospital center as well as in the team itself. Quality of life: Working in Biel, the bilingual city between lake and mountains, with high leisure value.

• Domain: Health professions
• Type: Full-time

Faites partie de notre équipe maintenant et façonnez l'avenir des soins! Vous êtes une sage-femme expérimentée et motivée qui cherche la prochaine étape avec beaucoup de responsabilités et de possibilités de co-création? Alors nous avons l'endroit parfait pour vous ! En tant que chef d'équipe, vous êtes responsable de notre service des naissances avec environ 900 naissances par an. En collaboration avec le deuxième chef d'équipe, Myriam Schwab, des experts et des responsables de l'éducation, vous nous aiderez à réaliser des améliorations et à assurer une qualité élevée. Il y a beaucoup de tâches grandes et variées qui vous attendent, postulez maintenant et apprenez plus! Pour renforcer le cercle de gestion, nous recherchons un chef d'équipe service de naissance / sage-femme (80-100%) au 01.09.2026 ou par accord: Vous êtes responsable de la prise en charge et du soutien holistiques des femmes enceintes, des enfants et des nouveau-nés ainsi que de leurs aidants.

Gestion et organisation du département de naissance dans un duo avec une équipe engagée et motivée d'environ 25 sages-femmes (y compris les heures de bureau ambulatoire à l'emplacement SZB, ainsi que les urgences gynécologiques en dehors des heures de bureau)

Coordination et gestion des projets de renouvellement et de développement de la clinique pour femmes

Optimisation et co-création du développement de spécialistes dans la Frauenklinik sur la base d'une utilisation ciblée des groupes de travail

Coresponsabilité dans l'obtention du mandat de formation des étudiants et la fixation des objectifs pour les employés en formation continue

Promouvoir la coopération constructive au sein de l'équipe ainsi que les domaines d'interface du Frauen-enklinik / Kinderklinik et des partenaires externes

Diplôme de sage-femme HF/FH avec plusieurs années d'expérience pratique dans le département de gestion des naissances expérience d'avantage Compétence sociale et empathie pour une rencontre professionnelle et humaine, même dans des situations complexes Haut sens des responsabilités avec une forte capacité organisationnelle, une façon structurée de travailler et d'agir économique Une personnalité ouverte et gagnante avec une grande orientation patiente, qui favorise activement la communication appréciatrice et une bonne coopération avec différents groupes professionnels langue maternelle allemand ou français et avec une bonne connaissance de l'autre langue (min. Sichere und fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen Sehr zentralgelegener und moderner Arbeitsort

Portfolio- und Assetmanager/in Immobilien im Gesundheitsbereich (80 – 100 %) - Spitalzentrum Biel / Centre hospitalier Bienne Die MEDIN Immobilien AG (MIAG) ist das neu gegründete Kompetenzcenter für alle Immobilienfragen für das Spitalzentrum Biel. Mit dem Spitalneubau in Brügg BE und dem Mieterausbau im Ambulatorium MEDIN am Bahnhof Biel sowie einigen Zusatznutzungen legt die MIAG den Grundstein für das zukünftige Immobilienportfolio mit Fokus auf Health und Hospitality. In den kommenden fünf Jahren liegt der Fokus in erfolgreichen Investitionen in dieses Gründungsportfolio. Es handelt sich um ein reines CREM-Portfolio (Corporate Real Estate Management). Portfolio e asset manager nel settore sanitario (80 - 100 %) - Hospital Center Biel / Centre Hospitalier Bienne MEDIN Immobilien AG (MIAG) è il nuovo centro di competenza fondato per tutte le questioni immobiliari per l'Hospital Center Biel. Con il nuovo edificio ospedaliero a Bruges BE e l'espansione dell'inquilino nell'imbolatorio MEDIN alla stazione di Biel e alcuni usi aggiuntivi, MIAG sta gettando le basi per il futuro portafoglio immobiliare con un focus sulla salute e l'ospitalità. Nei prossimi cinque anni, il focus sarà sugli investimenti di successo in questo portafoglio di start-up. Si tratta di un portafoglio puro CREM (corporate real estate management). Nei prossimi cinque anni, il focus sarà sugli investimenti di successo in questo portafoglio di start-up. È un portafoglio puro CREM (Corporate Real Estate Management). Pianificazione strategica e gestione del portafoglio immobiliare incl. Gli investimenti

Identificazione attiva e analisi delle opportunità di investimento e sviluppo nel portafoglio immobiliare, comprese le potenziali analisi

Preparazione, negoziazione e conclusione di accordi di livello di servizio con le unità organizzative partecipanti - Creazione e monitoraggio delle strategie di oggetti

Sviluppo del concetto per l'indagine sulle aree utilizzate internamente incl. Controllo e calcolo dell'area, nonché specifiche e standard per l'efficienza e l'occupazione nello spazio

Preparazione di rapporti di stato di costruzione, strategie di manutenzione e riparazione

Sviluppo di specifiche e standard per l'efficienza spaziale e l'occupazione

descriptionByLocale.en:
Portfolio and asset managers in the healthcare sector (80 - 100 %) - Hospital Center Biel / Centre hospitalier Bienne MEDIN Immobilien AG (MIAG) is the newly founded competence center for all real estate issues for the Hospital Center Biel. With the new hospital building in Bruges BE and the tenant expansion in the MEDIN ambulatorium at Biel station as well as some additional uses, MIAG is laying the foundation for the future real estate portfolio with a focus on health and hospitality. Over the next five years, the focus will be on successful investments in this start-up portfolio. It is a pure CREM (corporate real estate management) portfolio. With the new hospital building in Bruges BE and the tenant expansion in the MEDIN ambulatorium at Biel station as well as some additional uses, MIAG is laying the foundation for the future real estate portfolio with a focus on health and hospitality. Over the next five years, the focus will be on successful investments in this start-up portfolio. It is a pure CREM portfolio (Corporate Real Estate Management).To strengthen our team, we are looking for a proven professional as a portfolio and asset manager / in real estate in the health sector (80 – 100%) Creating a growth strategy for the next 5 to 10 years

Strategic planning and management of the real estate portfolio incl. Investments

Active identification and analysis of investment and development opportunities in the real estate portfolio including potential analyses

Preparation, negotiation and conclusion of service level agreements with the participating organizational units - Creation and monitoring of object strategies

Concept development for the survey of internally used areas incl. Area control and calculation as well as specifications and standards for area efficiency and space occupation

Preparation of construction status reports, maintenance and repair strategies

Development of specifications and standards for space efficiency and occupancy
